description: Implementation of the CU-UP (CU-User Plane) component for a 3GPP network, managing GTP-U demux, NG-U sessions, E1AP interface, and CU-UP lifecycle including start, stop, and statistics reporting.

classes.name: cu_up
classes.description: Class managing the CU-UP component, including lifecycle, GTP-U demux, NG-U sessions, E1AP interface, and statistics reporting.

methods.name: cu_up
methods.description: Constructor initializing CU-UP with configuration and dependencies, setting up GTP-U, NG-U, E1AP, and CU-UP manager.

methods.name: cu_up::~cu_up
methods.description: Destructor that stops the CU-UP component.

methods.name: cu_up::start
methods.description: Starts CU-UP, establishing connections, and initiating setup routines.

methods.name: cu_up::stop
methods.description: Stops CU-UP, terminating sessions, stopping timers, and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: cu_up::handle_stop_command
methods.description: Handles the stop command asynchronously, stopping timers, disconnecting interfaces, and stopping CU-UP manager.

methods.name: cu_up::on_statistics_report_timer_expired
methods.description: Logs current statistics and restarts the reporting timer.
